crossRefs.note: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.
When Moses heard it, he fell on his face.
They fell on their faces, and said, “God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and will you be angry…
“Get away from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!” They fell on their faces.
Moses cried to Yahweh, saying, “What shall I do with these people? They are almost ready to stone me.”
Joshua tore his clothes, and fell to the earth on his face before Yahweh’s ark until the evening, he and the elders of…
David lifted up his eyes, and saw Yahweh’s angel standing between earth and the sky, having a drawn sword in his hand…
They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.
In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.
He went forward a little, fell on his face, and prayed, saying, “My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass away…
Yahweh came down in a pillar of cloud, and stood at the door of the Tent, and called Aaron and Miriam; and they both…
But all the congregation threatened to stone them with stones. Yahweh’s glory appeared in the Tent of Meeting to all…
Korah assembled all the congregation opposite them to the door of the Tent of Meeting. Yahweh’s glory appeared to all…
When the congregation was assembled against Moses and against Aaron, they looked toward the Tent of Meeting. Behold…
As Aaron spoke to the whole congregation of the children of Israel, they looked toward the wilderness, and behold…

people.name: Moses

translations.web: Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and fell on their faces. Yahweh’s glory appeared to them.
translations.bsb: Then Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting. They fell facedown, and the glory of the LORD appeared to them.
translations.kjv: And Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they fell upon their faces: and the glory of the LORD appeared
translations.asv: And Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly unto the door of the tent of meeting, and fell upon their faces: and the glory of Jehovah appeared unto them.
